question: Should frozen release targets that predate `check:script-declarations` be exempted from that one current-main guard while still running the remaining release-validation checks?
rationale: The patch changes the release-validation compatibility contract; source-level string checks establish the branch logic, but only the release workflow owner can confirm the intended historical-target policy and acceptable validation coverage.

options.title: Approve the scoped exception
options.body: Accept the one-script historical exception after a successful frozen-target validation demonstrates that all remaining product checks still execute.

options.title: Backport the script contract
options.body: Require frozen release branches to declare the script instead, removing the compatibility exception at the cost of a release-branch backport.

recommendation.title: Approve the scoped exception
recommendation.body: Accept the one-script historical exception after a successful frozen-target validation demonstrates that all remaining product checks still execute.
